columns.IC50: Legacy released field name; the author-released processed scores lie in [0,1]. Used unchanged in the present study. The source publication describes LN IC50, but the release does not specify its conversion to this score scale. Metrics in this manuscript remain on the released score scale.

upstream_transformation: Not specified in the inspected DIPK release. Its exact published response CSV and stored input artifacts have been recovered and verified. Do not infer a new assay transformation from the score range.
reference_alignment_diagnostic: metadata/reference_response_alignment.json; empirical check only, not the original preprocessing code.
